notes.title: Bermuda released
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Btks7s5.png[/img]

Hello everyone! Thanks to your kind support, Bermuda has just been released on Steam. There will be a demo version available, so please feel free to check that out before making a decision.

To all Mac players, during testing, I have been informed that the game runs slower under full screen on some rigs. Switching to windowed mode appears to remedy the issue. As Bermuda is an older title, I really do apologize if you encounter this situation. Again, I would love for players to download the demo first to ensure they will have an ideal experience.

To those who have kindly purchased the game from other venues, here are the details:

IndieGala: I have sent a batch of keys to the bundle organizers. They will now upload the keys onto their system for players to obtain. This process usually takes around a week from my experience.

Humble Widget: I have just finished sending out keys to players via e-mail. If you do not receive a message after 24 hours, please feel free to contact me and I can get you sorted out.

Kickstarter: Same case as the Humble Widget players. Keys have been sent out via e-mail, so please check that inbox and junk folder just in case!

Desura: With my previous title, Unhack, I had great difficulty communicating with Desura to get the Steam keys uploaded. If you have purchased Bermuda on Desura, please shoot me a message and I will be happy to send a key over.

Thank you so much! I hope you will enjoy the game.
